protocol.reduced_pipeline: G8 not run (no extended universe; G8 can only veto, so null pass rates are upper bounds); oracles: G5 passes by definition (no params)

verdict.rule: G6 threshold = the LARGEST of G6_GRID whose null pass rate (Tier-1 passes / SUBMITTED pairs) is <= NULL_PASS_MAX under BOTH nulls; then oracle power at true Sharpe 1.5 >= POWER_MIN for BOTH speeds under BOTH nulls, with every oracle level's achieved mean VAL Sharpe within RHO_BOUND (0.1) of nominal; otherwise STOP
